2607.24377.title: MXAttention: Data-Free Optimal Scaling and Pre-Normalization Quantization for MXFP4 Attention
2607.24377.paper_summary: The quadratic cost of attention is a major bottleneck in diffusion-based video generation models. MXFP4 attention provides a promising path toward efficient inference, but direct MXFP4 quantization often degrades generation quality due to two numerical issues: the clipping-underflow trade-off from power-of-two scaling and the row-wise normalization error introduced in the softmax loop. We propose MXAttention, a data-free post-training quantization framework for MXFP4 attention. MXAttention introduces two components: Universal Optimal Scaling (UOS), which exploits the periodic structure of power-of-two microscaling to derive a distribution-independent optimal scaling boundary Qmax=7.25 without calibration or search, and Pre-Normalization Quantization (PNQ), which quantizes unnormalized softmax exponentials before row-wise summation to preserve normalization by construction. Experiments on Wan2.2 and HunyuanVideo show that MXAttention closes at least 95% of the VBench Imaging Quality gap between OCP MXFP4 and FP16, substantially improves frame-level similarity, and preserves FP16-level generation quality with less than 0.01 absolute degradation on all reported VBench metrics. MXAttention also achieves performance competitive with strong NVFP4-based baselines with negligible overhead when fused into the attention pipeline. The implementation is publicly available in MindIE-SD.
2607.24377.paper_summary_zh: 二次成本的注意力是基於擴散的視頻生成模型中的主要瓶頸。MXFP4 注意力提供了一條通向高效推理的有希望的途徑，但直接的 MXFP4 量化往往因為兩個數值問題而降低生成質量：來自二次幂縮放的剪裁-下溢權衡以及在 softmax 循環中引入的行級正規化誤差。我們提出了 MXAttention，一個針對 MXFP4 注意力的無數據後訓練量化框架。MXAttention 引入了兩個組件：通用最優縮放（UOS），它利用二次幂微縮的週期性結構來推導出一個與分佈無關的最優縮放邊界 Qmax=7.25，無需校準或搜索，以及預正規化量化（PNQ），它在行級求和之前對未正規化的 softmax 指數進行量化，以通過構造保留正規化。在 Wan2.2 和 HunyuanVideo 上的實驗顯示，MXAttention 至少縮小了 OCP MXFP4 和 FP16 之間 95% 的 VBench 成像質量差距，顯著改善了幀級相似性，並在所有報告的 VBench 指標上保留了 FP16 級別的生成質量，絕對降級小於 0.01。MXAttention 在與強大的 NVFP4 基準融合進注意力管道時，也實現了具有競爭力的性能，且開銷微不足道。實現已在 MindIE-SD 上公開提供。
